## Purpose

[backend/init_db.py](../../backend/init_db.py) is a **one-shot dev-bootstrap script**: it runs every Alembic migration
programmatically (`command.upgrade(alembic_cfg, "head")`) so a developer can initialise
`dev.db` without invoking the `alembic` CLI directly. It has no runtime callers — it is a
standalone entry point, not imported by the app or the agent kernel.

## Shape

- Resolves `backend/` as its own directory, `chdir`s into it (so `alembic.ini`'s relative
  paths resolve), and inserts it onto `sys.path` (so `app.*` imports work inside Alembic's
  [env.py](../../backend/alembic/env.py)).
- Builds an Alembic `Config` from `backend/alembic.ini` and calls `command.upgrade(cfg, "head")`.

## Why this shape

It exists solely because `alembic upgrade head` assumes a shell already `cd`'d into `backend/`
with the venv active; wrapping it in a script gives a single copy-pasteable command
(`python init_db.py`) for local setup.

It deliberately does nothing else — no seeding, no argument parsing, no error handling beyond
what Alembic itself raises. **That logic belongs to [backend/alembic/env.py](../../backend/alembic/env.py)** (see
`[MOD-backend-alembic](MOD-backend-alembic.md)`), which this script simply drives.
